test.create_query: CREATE TABLE flight_wide ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() EMPTY AS SELECT * FROM hits_10m_single
CREATE TABLE flight_narrow ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() EMPTY AS SELECT CounterID, EventDate, UserID, URL, SearchPhrase FROM hits_10m_single
CREATE VIEW flight_filtered AS SELECT * FROM hits_10m_single WHERE WatchID % 10 = 0
CREATE TABLE flight_sink_wide ENGINE = Null AS flight_wide
CREATE TABLE flight_sink_narrow ENGINE = Null AS flight_narrow
CREATE TABLE flight_check ENGINE = Memory AS flight_wide
CREATE TABLE flight_check_narrow ENGINE = Memory AS flight_narrow
